'''Forsaken Flags''' is a 2 RL map, and no LG. The layout has 2 bases on each sides of the map. Both of the bases have 1 Rocket Launcher, and 1 Mega, this is to encourage strategic gameplay around holding the bases and weapons.

The CTF version of the map: [[Mammoth]]
